stories.title: The death toll climbs from Monday's 7.4-magnitude earthquake in Colombia
stories.summary: Hundreds of rescue workers have been deployed in hardest hit cities trying to free victims still trapped under the rubble. Hundreds of people are still missing.

stories.title: The West's wildfire season is already breaking records, and it's not over
stories.summary: It's shaping up to be a historic wildfire season in the Western U.S. In Oregon, more acres have already burned than any time in modern history. At least 10 wildland firefighters have also died.

stories.title: In Spokane, those who lost homes to the fires are taking stock of the damage
stories.summary: Many of the people who lost their homes in the Spokane fires are just beginning to take stock of the damage and start to think about what it may look like to rebuild.

stories.title: What a forbidden hug from a nurse during lockdown meant to one a cancer patient
stories.summary: Shortly after the COVID-19 lockdown began, Ashleigh Bell Pedersen was diagnosed with an aggressive form of breast cancer. She came to desperately miss physical touch during treatment.

stories.title: How are schools adjusting sports for student athletes as sweltering heat lingers
stories.summary: As a new school year approaches, student athletes across Texas are returning to the field for fall sports, even as punishing heat lingers. How are rules and practices changing?

stories.title: Jackie, famous eagle from California eagle-cam, dies
stories.summary: Jackie, who was one half of the famous mated eagle pair Jackie and Shadow, died this week. The birds' eagle-cam livestream has fans across the world.
